newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish bonds start lower, French budget in focus.
newsitem.headline: Danish bonds start lower, French budget in focus.

text.p: Danish bonds opened lower on Monday and dealers predicted little movement with the revised French budget and U.S. Fed chairman Alan Greenspan's upcoming Humphrey Hawkins speech in focus.
"We do not see much movement in the market until Greenspan's speech on Tuesday. The revised French budget could spark renewed EMU fears," one dealer said.

The benchmark eight percent state bond due 2006 opened down 0.13 point from Friday's close at 113.82, yielding 5.90 percent. The forthcoming seven percent 2007 benchmark was down by the same margin at 106.62, with yield at 6.10 percent.
The 2007's 10-year yield gap with Germany widened one basis point to 54. The crown stood at 3.8081 per mark at 0715 GMT, firming a little from Friday's 3.8085.
